description: Cruise around and experience the freedom of a safe, fast, and reliable ebike. Our fleet has powerful 48V 840WH batteries with 40+ mile range that can help you navigate flat ground, hills, and even windy conditions. Our multiple speed ebikes come with reliable hydraulic disc brakes to ensure for a safe adventure. Renting an ebike is the best way to experience the beautiful scenery southern California has to offer.
what_to_bring:
-Appropriate clothing and footwear.
-Helmet and lock are provided.
faqs:
-Weight Maximum: 275 lbs capacity for each bike.
-Party Size Maximum: We can take up to 15 people in a party.
